Population increased in Redbridge

The estimated population of Redbridge in 2024 was 321,231 usual residents, a rise of 1.5% since 2023.

This meant that Redbridge's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Redbridge increased by 3.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Redbridge was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Redbridge

The average (median) age fell to 35.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Redbridge has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Redbridge is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Redbridge's population of 321,231 usual residents was made up of:

  • 69,428 people aged 0 to 15 years, (21.6%)
  • 211,439 people aged 16 to 64 years, (65.8%)
  • 40,364 people aged 65 years and over, (12.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Redbridge has a lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (12.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Redbridge, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Redbridge
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Redbridge, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 2,580 people (0.8%). In total, there were 4,298 births and 1,718 deaths in Redbridge.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 7,754 (-2.4%). There were 25,526 people entering the area and 33,280 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Redbridge's population of 9,842 (3.1%) as a result of 13,797 people entering the area and 3,955 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Redbridge was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Redbridge in mid-2023 is 316,556.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 4,479 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 1,315 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 3,164 people.
